rows.text: 1.1 · Release day: Settings › Pricing opens on Tiers. On release day only Default exists. Every customer is on Default, so no price changes until the client sets up tiers.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 1.2 · Release day: Matrices tab. Today's matrices come across as they are, each with only its Default column.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)
canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 1.4 · Result: Opening a matrix shows today's rules as the Default column. Nothing else to set up.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)
canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.1 · Today: the Pricing page. Screenshot of production today; the screens after it show what changes.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.2 · Tiers list. Settings › Pricing › Tiers. Active tiers by number, then archived ones. Default has no badge: its name says it.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.3 · Hover the # info icon. The tooltip explains the tier order. Numbers are plain text under the #.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.4 · Click the three-dot menu beside New Tier. The list-level menu holds Audit Log.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)
canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.6 · Result: "Audit Log: Tiers": every tier's changes, newest first. (Also Story 19.)
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.7 · Click a tier's three-dot menu (never used). Tier 5 has priced nothing: Audit Log, Archive, Delete.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.8 · Hover the greyed Delete. A tier that open work orders, estimates or Part Sales use, or that priced saved lines, can't be deleted. Hovering Delete gives the reason.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.9 · The last row's menu opens upward. Fleet Old is the last row, so its menu opens upward and stays in view. (Also Story 19.)
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)
canvas note or board title (designer annotation)
canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.11 · Result: The new tier's page opens, no dialog, with the cursor in the name and Cancel / Create Tier. It will be the last tier.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.12 · Click Create Tier with no name. A name is required.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.13 · Type a name another tier uses. Names are unique among active and archived tiers, ignoring case.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.14 · Type an archived tier's name. The archived tier must be renamed first.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.15 · Type a name the reports use. "Manual is used by the reports. Choose another name." Manual, Fixed price, Fixed line total and Before tiers are reserved, in any letter case; the message names the reserved name as written.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.16 · Type "Fleet Plus" and click Create Tier.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.17 · Result: The tier is created and its page stays open. It prices the same as the tier before it until its rules are set.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)
canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.18 · Archive a tier that has customers.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.19 · Click "Remove Customers" in the blocked dialog.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.20 · Result: Manage Customers opens on the Remove tab, so the customers can be taken off and the tier archived.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.21 · Archive a tier with no customers.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.22 · Result: The dialog lists, one per line, every tier that follows it through Same as previous tier.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)
canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.24 · Result: Tier 5 moves to the archived rows; the tiers after it move up one number.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.25 · An archived tier's menu. Reactivate puts it back as the last tier.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)
canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.27 · Result: No confirmation. Tier 5 comes back as the last tier.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.28 · Delete a tier that priced nothing.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.29 · Click Delete. This can't be undone.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.30 · Result: The tier and its column in every matrix are gone.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: Archive, reactivate or delete a tier (2.18–2.30)
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)
canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.32 · Result: The tier's page opens on Pricing: every matrix and how it prices this tier, in the grid's words.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.33 · Point at the name. The rename pencil shows while the pointer is over the name (always on touch screens).
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)
canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.35 · Result: The name is edited in place. Enter or clicking away saves; Esc cancels.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.36 · Type a taken name and press Enter. Same name rules as New Tier; nothing is saved.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.37 · Type "Fleet" and press Enter. Saved at once. Lines and reports show the new name.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.38 · Click the page's three-dot menu. Audit Log, Archive, and Delete (greyed when the tier priced lines).
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)
canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.40 · Result: "Audit Log: Tier 2": Event, User, Details (old → new), Date, Time. (Also Story 19.)
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)
canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.42 · Result: Default is priced by each matrix's Default column, so its page has no checkboxes and no Set Rule.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)
canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.44 · Result: Archived shows as plain text. It can be renamed and repriced but takes no customers.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.45 · Click a matrix on the tier's page.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.46 · Result: The matrix opens in edit with Tier 2's column in view; the breadcrumb leads back to the tier.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)
canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.47 · Check a matrix. The bulk bar appears at the top of the list: count, "Set Tier 2 to", rule, value, Set Rule, clear.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.48 · Click select-all. Every matrix, Active and Inactive, is checked.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.49 · Uncheck two. The header checkbox shows partly checked.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.50 · Type 35. The rule starts on % Off. The other types are in the same picker, grouped as in the grid: Off default price (% Off, $ Off), From cost (+ $, Markup %, Margin %).
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.51 · Click Set Rule with no value. Blocked, with the message by the bar.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.52 · Pick Margin %, type 120, click Set Rule. "Enter a margin from 0 to 99.99"; nothing changes.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.53 · Click Set Rule (every matrix checked). "in all <n> matrices" only when every matrix is checked; inactive ones are counted.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.54 · Click Set Rule (some checked). Only the checked matrices change.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.55 · Click Set Rule in the dialog.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.56 · Result: The checks clear. The toast stays 20 seconds, pauses while pointed at, and has Undo.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)
canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.58 · Result: Exactly what the tier had comes back.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.59 · Set a rule it already has.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 2.60 · Result: Nothing is asked; a toast says so.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: Set one rule for a tier (2.47–2.60)
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)
canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 3.2 · Result: The matrix page: Categories, Work Order / Part Sale tabs, the tier grid (Default and every active tier) and the Price Part Simulator.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 3.3 · Point at the name. The rename pencil shows on hover; the name is renamed in place.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)
canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 3.5 · Result: Enter or clicking away saves at once; Esc cancels.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 3.6 · Click the page's three-dot menu. Audit Log for this matrix.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)
canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 3.8 · Result: Newest first: each save, then every rule it changed. (Also Story 19.)
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)
canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 3.10 · Result: No badge on the page; the reason shows as plain text.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)
canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 3.11 · Save a matrix that prices one category.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 3.12 · Result: Saved without asking; a toast confirms.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 3.13 · Save a matrix that prices several categories. "Change Prices in <n> Categories?" lists every category, one per line: Cancel / Change All.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 3.14 · Save the General Matrix. It confirms, naming the categories without a matrix of their own.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 3.15 · Type 120 in a % Off column and click Save. The % Off message; Save is blocked.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 3.16 · Change a value, then click the Part Sale Matrix tab. "Discard these changes?" Each tab has its own Edit, Save and Cancel. Keep Editing stays; Discard Changes opens the Part Sale Matrix tab.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)
canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 3.17 · Click the Part Sale Matrix tab (off). Part Sales use the work order prices until separate Part Sale pricing is turned on. (Also Story 13.)
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 3.18 · Turn on separate Part Sale pricing. It starts as a copy of the work order prices.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 3.19 · A matrix with its own Part Sale prices. Tread Plus Part Sale Matrix: same grid, its own rules. (Also Story 13.)
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 3.20 · Turn it off. "Turn off Part Sale pricing?" Cancel / Turn Off. (Also Story 13.)
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)
canvas note or board title (designer annotation)
canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 3.22 · Result: Name, categories and the grid ready to fill; Cancel and Create Matrix in the page head, as on New Tier and New Category.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 3.23 · Open Categories. Search and tick categories; one already on another matrix says so.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 3.24 · Click Create Matrix with no name. Matrix name is a required field.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 3.25 · Type a taken name and click Create Matrix. "A matrix called Stop 40 already exists."
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)
canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 3.27 · Result: A copy of its rules, ready to name.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)
canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 3.29 · Result: "Delete Stop 40?" names the matrix. Its categories go to the General Matrix.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: New, duplicate or delete a matrix (3.21–3.29)
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 4.1 · Hover the Cost Range info icon. Short tooltip explaining cost ranges.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 4.2 · Hover a "Uses previous tier" cell. Names the previous tier by number and name: "Uses previous tier, 1 · Default." Through a chain it adds the tier whose rule prices it: "Uses previous tier, 2 · Tier 2. Priced by 1 · Default’s rule."
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 4.3 · A column that mixes rule types.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 4.4 · Result: Tread Plus Default: + $45 up to $300, then 15% margin. In edit, the column's rule picker reads "Mixed rules" (4.15); the Categories list reads the same.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)
canvas note or board title (designer annotation)
canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 4.6 · Result: Every cell is editable. The bar shows "No changes yet", Cancel and Save.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 4.7 · Type in a range. The ranges below that are empty or gray fill in gray with the same rule type and value. Gray values don't count as changes.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 4.8 · Change range 2 to Markup % and type 45. Auto-fill follows the last range entered: range 3 and below follow range 2.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 4.9 · A column's rule picker. Previous tier · Off default price (% Off, $ Off) · From cost (+ $, Markup %, Margin %). Picking one sets the whole column.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 4.10 · Default's rule picker. Default can only use From cost types (+ $, Markup %, Margin %): no Previous tier, no % Off or $ Off.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 4.11 · Pick % Off for Tier 5. % Off starts at 0% in every range.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 4.12 · Pick "Previous tier" for Tier 2. The column shows the previous tier's values, muted; it prices the same as the tier before it.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 4.13 · A From cost cell's symbol. The $ or % is a picker (chevron on the far right) so one range can use another From cost type. Alt+Down opens it.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)
canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 4.15 · Result: The column header reads "Mixed rules"; cells spell out % markup / % margin.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 4.16 · Same as previous tier, in edit.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 4.17 · Result: The cells show the previous tier's values, muted, and can be typed over to give the tier its own copy.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 4.18 · Type a bad value and click Save. Cells highlighted; the message names the problem; Save is blocked.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 4.19 · Change a range end. Ranges are entered by their end; the next range starts a cent later.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 4.20 · Click Add Range. A new last range; counts as one change.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 4.21 · Click a range's delete. The range above takes its end; counts as one change.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 4.22 · After a few edits. Changed cells are highlighted; the bar counts only cells someone edited.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 4.23 · Click Cancel with changes. "Discard these changes?" Keep editing / Discard changes. (Also Story 19.)
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)
canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 4.24 · Change Default's rules. The confirm names every tier that prices from Default in this matrix. Dynamic 26 prices 3 categories, so the list joins "Change Prices in 3 Categories?"; a one-category matrix asks "Change Default's Prices?". (Also Story 3.)
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)
canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 4.26 · Result: The archived view: Default plus archived tiers, with a notice; only the archived columns can change.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 4.27 · Hover Default's column in the archived view. "Default prices live parts, so it can't be changed in the archived view."
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: Change Default's rules; the archived view (4.24–4.27)
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 5.1 · Type a part cost in the Price Part Simulator. Every column shows the sell price and profit for that cost. Nothing is saved.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 5.2 · A cost a tier sells below. The same triangle marks a below-cost price. (Also Story 15.)
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 5.3 · Type 0 as the part cost. The cost field shows an error and every column shows “—”. The same happens when the field is empty or not a number.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 5.4 · Type a cost while editing the grid. The simulator uses the unsaved values in the grid.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)
canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 6.1 · Today: the matrices list. Screenshot of production today; the screens after it show what changes.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 6.2 · Click the Matrices tab. Every matrix: Status, Categories, Work Order Matrix, Part Sale Matrix, and which tiers have their own rules.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 6.3 · Hover the Tiers info icon. The Tiers column lists the numbers of the tiers with their own rules, or "All".
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 6.4 · Hover the tier numbers in the Tiers column. The numbers of the tiers with their own rules; their names on hover.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 6.5 · Click the Status filter. Active and Inactive. Inactive = no category uses the matrix.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)
canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 6.7 · Result: The chip turns blue with the selection.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 6.8 · Hover an Inactive status. "No categories use this matrix."
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 6.9 · Search "tread". Search matches matrix and category names.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 6.10 · A search with no match. The standard empty state with Clear Search.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 6.11 · Click a matrix's three-dot menu. Duplicate, Delete.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 6.12 · The General Matrix's menu. The General Matrix can't be deleted; hovering Delete says why.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)
canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 6.14 · Result: "Audit Log: Matrices": every matrix's changes, deleted ones included. (Also Story 19.)
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)
canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 7.1 · Today: the Categories list. Screenshot of production today; the screens after it show what changes.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 7.2 · Today: Edit Category. Screenshot of production today; the screens after it show what changes.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 7.3 · Settings › Categories. Every category's pricing at a glance: its matrix, and each tier's rule in short.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 7.4 · Hover a "Uses previous tier" cell. The hover lists each cost range on its own line; a "Uses previous tier" cell names the previous tier by number and name, and the tier whose rule prices it.
rows.basis: canvas note or board title (designer annotation)

rows.text: 7.5 · Search "tire". Search matches category and matrix names.
